Check the battery switch. Q3 IRLML6402 P-MOS. Source at J6 pin1 (battery positive). Drain to BAT bus. Gate to R14 47k to source and SW2 to GND. When switch open, gate pulled to source via 47k, Vgs=0, MOSFET off. Body diode? For P-channel, body diode from drain to source. Check D3 PMEG3030EP. +5V to servo rail. Anode +5V, cathode servo rail. Vf ~0.36V at 3A. Good. Blocks backfeed from servo rail to +5V. Good.

Check C8 0.1u on +3V3. Good.
